pr_title: fix: Two finger panning is slow
pr_body:
fix #2497
fix https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/6913

With this change, two finger panning on iPad matches the single finger panning with the hand tool. I tested this with various zoom levels.

sorry - can't figure out how to update tests to accommodate the change :(

issue_context.title: Firefox scrolling is slow
issue_context.body:
Firefox `wheel` event deltas are really tiny in comparison to other browsers.

For example, in Chrome on my mouse, `deltaY` is `166`, whereas in Firefox it is `5`.

Known, WONTFIX issue: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1057252

(via https://twitter.com/midned/status/1336717295004037123)
comments: Maybe there's some normalization we can do, but would require extensive testing with all possible input modes (touchscreen, touchpad, mouse with continuous, non-discrete wheels...).
The OP said Figma is affected as well, but I can't repro. So if Figma figured it out, we can too.

I have the same problem in Firefox: scrolling with laptop trackpad is 20x slowwe in FF than in Chrome.

Also the "?" keyboard help suggests Space + Drag or Wheel + Drag to move the canvas. On my Linux laptop, Space + anything on my trackpad does nothing.

Just saw the web app in a video, tried it myself - looks nice but there is this annoying navigation issue when using Firefox + touch pad two-finger gesture panning (zooming&moving around) - it is not only slow but it has a significant delay which ruins the experience.

review_comments: why 2x? Isn't this more related to `devicePixelRatio` which on most mobile touchscreens would coincide with `2`?
